evals.prompt: does render.com have any webmcp tools? if so list them
evals.expected_output: Detects navigator.modelContext + modelContextTesting are present and lists the 5 render.* tools (docs.search, docs.get-markdown, blog.get-index, articles.get-index, llms.get-index) with their input schemas.

evals.prompt: use webmcp on render.com to search the docs for 'background worker' and tell me the top result
evals.expected_output: Calls render.docs.search via executeTool with JSON.stringify({query:'background worker'}), parses structuredContent, reports 'Background Workers' as the top hit. Does not pass args as a raw object.

evals.prompt: i opened https://googlechromelabs.github.io/webmcp-tools/demos/pizza-maker/ in my webmcp chrome but listTools() returns nothing. whats wrong?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses by checking console errors, identifies the SecurityError from http:// origins in the exposedTo list aborting all registrations, explains it's a site bug not the user's setup.
